parameters.content:
## Scheduled portfolio demonstration
34 fictional accounts, up to 8 per model call. Five successful initial batches populate the review queue. Repeat ticks do not regenerate completed batches. One returned draft is revised per tick.

Paste storage_config from Setup complete into Run settings. Select your Gateway/OpenAI credential in Classify and draft. Publish only after the authenticated review form is configured.

Leave force_run_key blank and simulate_input_failure off for normal runs. The optional failure test drops one delivery record in memory and must fail before any model call. Source tables are not edited.

All generated versions need fresh human review. No sending node is present. A full runtime demonstration is still required; local checks alone do not prove n8n operation.

FIX01: calendar comparisons are computed before the model call; Amber signatures must use full names. With Select batch FIX01 installed, force_run_key RESUME-01 retries failed rows once per batch and continues unfinished initial batches. Completed rows remain unchanged. A second failure with that key stops for inspection. Clear the resume key once recovery is complete.

FIX02: terminal legacy UNASSIGNED failures are linked only through a unique execution ID and retained error payload. RESUME recovery can reclaim matching Processing versions with exact token checks. Original audit rows stay unchanged; the new RUN_STARTED records recovery_context. Failure capture uses explicit main-output/run indexes and records lookup problems.

FIX03 operating design: classification/urgency/draft routing are calculated in code using the unchanged rubric. The model receives these decisions and writes explanations and personalised drafts. Later outputs are policy-guided drafting results, NOT independent model-classification accuracy. Original model errors remain in evidence. Human approval remains required. Use a new explicit RESUME key after inspecting a failed attempt.
